complicacoes.texto: Eradicator is obsessed with preserving the culture and knowledge of the planet Krypton, no matter how little of it remains.

Eradicator loses his Powers under a red sun. Other effects draining or interfering with the energies of the yellow sun can deprive him of his Energy Raio, Voo, Super-Sentidos, Super-Velocidade, and Super-Força.
Eradicator is as Vulnerável to mágico as anyone else. His Resistência is not Impenetrável against magical attacks.

Eradicator has a weakness to kryptonite, the radioactive remains of the planet Krypton. Kryptonite comes in a number of forms. Green kryptonite is by far the most common. Its Radiação saps his Força, Voo, Super-Sentidos, Super-Velocidade, and Super-Força, leaving him impaired, disabled, and eventually debilitated in terms of Força and power effects. Long-term exposure (usually a matter of minutes, less for a large enough amount) imposes the Moribundo condition and may lead to death. PERSONALITY The Eradicator is a Frio and dispassionate being, most often ruled by logic and his directive of preserving Kryptonian cul - ture and heritage. At times, David Connor’s personality has become dominant, giving the Eradicator a more human-like and emotional countenance. Powers & Abilities The Eradicator possesses all the Powers and Abilities of a Kryptonian exposed to yellow sun Radiação. In addition, he is able to manipulate energy to produce various types of blasts, possesses a vast computer Intelecto, and is able to detect in - terdimensional beings and gateways. ALLIES The Eradicator has been allied with the Outsiders on occa - sion, and is considered part of Superman’s extended family. ENEMIES The Eradicator has at times directly opposed Superman.
